registryEntry.label: PIM Separation of Duties - Require Approval
registryEntry.get_command: $roleId=(Get-MgRoleManagementDirectoryRoleDefinition -Filter "displayName eq 'Compliance Administrator'").Id; $pimPolicyId=(Get-MgPolicyRoleManagementPolicyAssignment -Filter "scopeId eq '/' and scopeType eq 'DirectoryRole' and roleDefinitionId eq '$roleId'" | Select-Object -First 1).PolicyId; Get-MgPolicyRoleManagementPolicyRule -UnifiedRoleManagementPolicyId $pimPolicyId -Filter "id eq 'Approval_EndUser_Assignment'" | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
